translations.web: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
translations.bsb: We work hard with our own hands. When we are vilified, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
translations.kjv: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:
